newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, expect extended range trading.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, expect extended range trading.

text.p: June Brent crude futures in Asia were steady on Friday in range bound trade looking for a break out one way or the other, brokers said.
June Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $18.30 per barrel, up one cent from the London settlement on Thursday.
The SIMEX and London Brent markets will close on Monday to mark a U.K. holiday.
Brokers said the failure of the June contract to break above resistance at $18.77 on Wednesday was likely to extend the current range trading.
Some analysts cited the range as $18.20 to $18.77, while some others cited a narrower $18.00/$18.50 in the short term.
"The market has tried a few times to move higher and hasn't made any new lows, which is positive. That is all we have to grab onto at the moment," one senior broker said.
NYMEX crude was trading quietly on ACCESS.
June last traded at $19.91, flat with New York on moderate volume of 421 lots.
